datasets.title: Finland Total Electricity Consumption
datasets.description: Total electricity consumption in Finland calculated from production and cross-border import/export.

datasets.title: Finland Total Electricity Production
datasets.description: Total domestic electricity production across all Finnish power plants.

datasets.title: Finland Wind Power Generation
datasets.description: Real-time wind power production in Finland for residual load and renewable penetration modeling.

datasets.title: Finland Nuclear Power Production
datasets.description: Baseload nuclear power generation across Finnish reactors.

datasets.title: Finland Hydro Power Production
datasets.description: Real-time hydro power generation in Finland providing flexible dispatch and frequency balancing.

datasets.title: Finland District Heating CHP Production
datasets.description: Combined heat and power electricity produced alongside municipal district heating.

datasets.title: Finland Industrial CHP Production
datasets.description: Combined heat and power electricity generated by Finnish forest, chemical, and manufacturing industries.

datasets.title: Finland Net Electricity Import/Export
datasets.description: Real-time net cross-border electricity exchange (+ indicates net import into Finland; - indicates net export).

datasets.title: Finland ↔ Northern Sweden (SE1) Interconnector Flow
datasets.description: Cross-border AC transmission between Finland and Sweden bidding zone SE1 (+ import to FI, - export to SE1).

datasets.title: Finland ↔ Central Sweden (SE3) Fenno-Skan HVDC Flow
datasets.description: Subsea HVDC transmission between Finland and Sweden bidding zone SE3 (+ import to FI, - export to SE3).

datasets.title: Finland ↔ Northern Norway (NO4) Interconnector Flow
datasets.description: Cross-border transmission between Finnish Lapland and Norway bidding zone NO4 (+ import to FI, - export to NO4).

datasets.title: Finland ↔ Estonia (EE) EstLink HVDC Flow
datasets.description: Subsea EstLink 1 & 2 HVDC transmission between Finland and Estonia (+ import to FI, - export to EE).

datasets.title: Finland Grid Consumption Emission Factor
datasets.description: Real-time carbon intensity of electricity consumed in Finland including cross-border net imports.

datasets.title: Denmark (DK1+DK2) Total Electricity Consumption
datasets.description: Hourly gross electricity consumption across Western (DK1) and Eastern (DK2) Denmark via Energinet.

datasets.title: Denmark (DK1+DK2) Onshore & Offshore Wind Generation
datasets.description: Combined Danish onshore and offshore wind turbine electricity generation via Energinet.
datasets.license: Energinet / Nord Pool Open Data (CC BY 4.0)

datasets.title: Denmark (DK1+DK2) Solar PV Generation
datasets.description: Hourly solar photovoltaic generation across Denmark via Energinet.
datasets.license: Energinet / Nord Pool Open Data (CC BY 4.0)

datasets.title: Denmark (DK1+DK2) Grid CO2 Emission Intensity
datasets.description: Hourly grid CO2 emission intensity in Denmark averaged across DK1 and DK2 via Energinet.
datasets.license: Energinet / Nord Pool Open Data (CC BY 4.0)

datasets.title: Finland Multi-City Ambient Temperature (2m)
datasets.description: Hourly 2m air temperature across 5 Finnish cities plus national mean (includes 48h forecast) for Heating Degree Day modeling.

datasets.title: Finland Multi-City Hub-Height Wind Speed (100m)
datasets.description: Hourly 100m hub-height wind speed across 5 Finnish cities (including Vaasa and Oulu wind corridors) for wind generation curve modeling.

datasets.title: Finland (FI) Day-Ahead Electricity Spot Price
datasets.description: Hourly Nord Pool Day-Ahead electricity spot price for Finland bidding zone FI (EUR/MWh, excluding VAT).
